notes: City of Plano, TX: the whole city within city limits, across Collin County (180 km2) and Denton County (the 6.7 km2 strip on the west edge). Built by data/jurisidictions/run_plano.py (collin_county.py + pacs_city.py + tx_pipeline.py). 77,091 parcels, $21.11B land (Collin $20.38B, Denton $734M). All values 2026.

Values: Collin Central Appraisal District's own public parcel layer (CCAD Parcel Feature Set, data of 2026-10-23). The layer has rolled to the 2027 roll year, so the 2026 certified values are its prior-year fields (prevValYear 2026: land, improvement, market); 184 properties created for 2027 have no 2026 value; 5 properties split for 2027 are re-joined with their child polygons so each 2026 value sits on the land it was appraised for. Check: CCAD's taxable (non-exempt, non-utility) land on City of Plano properties is $20.379B vs $20.377B kept here.

Denton County: Denton Central Appraisal District's 2026 certified export (PACS 8.0.33, exported 2026-07-27) joined on prop_id to Denton CAD's own certified parcel polygons (Parcels_Certified_2026, from its nightly geodatabase); both downloaded by hand (dentoncad.com is not reachable from the build host). City of Plano: entity C29; 2,123 accounts.
City limits: Census TIGER/Line 2025 place 4858016; the counties' City of Plano codes (Collin CPL, Denton C29) agree on all but 5 / 3 accounts.

Exempt land dropped: CCAD's total exemption codes (EX-XV public property, EX-XJ schools... and CHODO), Denton CAD's EX flags, plus named public owners: 1,112 records. Homestead / disabled-veteran exemptions are personal and those homes stay in. 53 utility records left off.

Condos and townhomes: CCAD draws many condo units as unit outlines. 1,714 units in 120 developments are merged onto their land (28 onto their own common-area parcel, the rest onto the unit hull grown into unparcelled ground), including developments numbered by unit with no lot (Parkbluff, Springwood Creek, Briarpark Village) and office condos ('% CMN INT': Midway Medical Center, West Plano Medical Center). 221 polygons carry stacked records (undivided-interest shares, summed). 560 leftover nominal common areas (359 ac) dropped like exempt land.
Land size: appraiser acreage when within 25% of the polygon; 54 parcels drawn as fragments of their roll area use the appraiser's area; 17 remnants hidden.

Singularity sweep: 15 of 77,091 parcels, all at most 8.2x the neighbourhood: downtown townhome lots (1897 Townhomes, 17th Street Townhomes at ~$90-97/sqft), the Mapleplex office condo on its plat polygon, and one Shiloh Park unit (4.7x).
Under 100k parcels: browser GeoParquet path, no PMTiles bake.

Parking is OSM delivered through Overture Maps (release 2026-10-21.0, --overture-only), classified surface vs structure: 739 lots, 860.3 acres, $884M est. land value (Legacy / Granite Park office parking). apply_parking_category.py tagged 51 parcels 'Parking Lot'.

Links: Collin parcels open Collin CAD's eSearch page pinned to 2026 (esearch.collincad.org/Property/View/<prop_id>?year=2026; confirmed by the user); Denton parcels Denton CAD's property page (denton.prodigycad.com/property-detail/<prop_id>/2026, the pattern Denton CAD's own data uses).

Satellite-detected parking (beta, dev): same model as Laredo (trained on Laredo + 33 Plano squares). On 78 Blind random squares never used in training: 91% precision, 67% recall. Map 18.1 km2 incl. lots on land with no parcel (public/exempt); survey alone 21.1 +/- 2.4 km2, map-calibrated 25.5 +/- 1.5 km2: they disagree, quote about 21-26 km2. Validation: data/scripts/parking_validation/plano.json.
